camel_example: aliyun sas ListGroups --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --NextToken 1426C575705AE8545E8360A6EFA3B000 --CurrentPage 89 --Lang zh --UseNextToken true
description_en: Retrieves the list of server groups for the current user
description_zh: 获取用户的主机服务器分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas list-groups --lang zh --current-page 89 --page-size 10 --next-token 1426C575705AE8545E8360A6EFA3B000 --use-next-token true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGroups

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据当前页的页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，最大2000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no additional results exist. If NextToken has a value, the value indicates the token to use for the next query
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

true: Uses the NextToken method.
false: Does not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token
